answers.reason: The stipulated registry binds R17 to K8 and K8 to P02. Administrative filenames do not change that provenance.

The supplied graph is a forward chain with no feedback edge, and no existing causal link is removed. Calling it a closed loop does not supply the required semantics; the separate diagram does not repair the first proposal.

Concurrent creative-arm families remain unreviewed. Comparative raw exclusivity requires coverage of concurrent ordinary and creative raw families, including uncertain equivalence links; archive distinction and independent strategy/ordinary reviews are insufficient.

The candidate preserves the blocker output and causal path and supplies no disturbance-derived signal, energy, or control path. Renaming resistance as harvesting does not establish conversion; the separate hypothetical is not candidate evidence.
The hybrid gain equals the sum of the individual gains, and disconnecting the proposed interface leaves performance unchanged. These observations do not establish a causal interaction or synergy.

The enabling experiment indispensably depends on borrowed-sensor access, which is unconfirmed. No hard-constraint relaxation is requested, so conditional is unwarranted; compliance under supplied resources is not established.

A supplied trigger path establishes relocation of alert detection to the latch. Daily inspection and incident jam clearing retain human work, while the proposal omits its responsibility and cost and overclaims elimination. The transfer is supported but the complete relocation account is not.

Both rival causes predict an observable persistence result. The proposed test does not distinguish them and supplies no defeat condition, so it supports an observable prediction but not observability 2.

The causal uncertainty changes the intervention choice. A bounded cache-disable probe produces distinct predictions, each account has a defeat condition, and joint prediction failure explicitly preserves the unresolved contradiction.

R3 lacks the required causal-relation, discriminator, and uncertainty traces and any disposition. A required independent review also lacks a terminal record; launching jobs does not establish completion.

F3 has an unresolved equivalence link to the unchanged first slot F1 and is excluded. F4 is the next eligible confirmed-distinct family without an uncertain link. Its partial operator contract remains eligible under the explicit P10 policy.

The contrapositive preserves the Boolean discriminator, but case-local equivalence also requires the operation, carrier, and causal path. B does not specify its carrier or physical causal path, so full equivalence or causal distinction cannot be resolved.
